discordance_calibration.model: Logistic regression for clinical agreement using continuous absolute log ratio; descriptive bins fixed at <0.10, 0.10-0.25, 0.25-0.50, and >0.50 only for visualization
outcomes: Within-bout directional stability where two segment estimates are available
discordance_calibration.population: Locked V1 same-day SP primary cohort
discordance_calibration.safeguard: The 0.10 boundary will not exclude participants or redefine the primary analysis

exact_sample_head_to_head.arm_measure: Locked median peak angular velocity lower-side classification
estimands: Paired difference in clinical-direction agreement with participant bootstrap 95% CI
Exact McNemar test based on arm-only versus step-only concordance
Spearman association between signed sensor ratios and signed clinical laterality
exact_sample_head_to_head.interpretation: Estimation-first and exploratory; no claim of confirmatory superiority
exact_sample_head_to_head.population: Participants in the locked V1 same-day SP primary cohort with valid bilateral step length from the same SelfPace walking bout
exact_sample_head_to_head.step_measure: Mean contralateral landing-foot step length by side, minimum four steps per side, log(R/L), shorter side classified as sensor-lower side

changes.multiplicity: All new p values are descriptive and exploratory. Confidence intervals and compatibility across definitions take priority.
changes.reporting: Keep the locked primary result first. Label additions in Methods, Results, abstract, tables, and supplement as post-result exploratory analyses.
changes.timing_and_status: Created after inspection of the locked arm-swing results and the existing Claude pipeline outputs. Every added analysis is post-result exploratory; the original H1 and H2 estimands and success criteria remain unchanged.

triangulation.alternate_arm_pipeline: The existing 0.3-3 Hz PCA-RMS pipeline will be audited against source code and outputs and described as an alternative analytic pipeline on overlapping data
triangulation.controls: The PD-control arm-swing asymmetry comparison will be supportive construct evidence only, adjusted for age, sex, and height, with the null mean-amplitude result reported

reason: Add transparent post-result exploratory arm-versus-step comparison, discordance calibration, and alternative-pipeline triangulation without modifying locked primary analyses
